NEED_BELONGING.definition: The fundamental psychological drive to be accepted, included, and loved within a social unit or community.

NEED_COURAGE.definition: The internal drive to confront physical, emotional, or social vulnerability despite fear.

NEED_PATIENCE.definition: The capacity to tolerate delay, frustration, or slow progress without anxiety or anger.

NEED_RESPONSIBILITY.definition: The obligation to care for oneself, others, or shared tasks and accept consequences.

NEED_AUTONOMY.definition: The impulse to exercise self-governance, make independent choices, and test boundaries.

NEED_COMPASSION.definition: The capacity to recognize distress in others and feel driven to relieve it.

NEED_COMPETENCE.definition: The drive to master skills, solve problems, and achieve a sense of capability.

NEED_IDENTITY.definition: The need to understand one's unique characteristics, role, and self-worth.

NEED_SAFETY.definition: The basic need for physical protection, emotional security, and predictable boundaries.

NEED_STABILITY.definition: The desire for consistency, routine, and a firm foundation during times of transition.

NEED_EXPRESSION.definition: The drive to communicate internal thoughts, feelings, and creative impulses outward.

NEED_JUSTICE.definition: The psychological need for fairness, equity, and the correction of wrongs.

NEED_CURIOSITY.definition: The intrinsic motivation to explore, question, learn, and discover truth.

NEED_CONNECTION.definition: The need for deep, reciprocal emotional intimacy and mutual understanding.

NEED_FORGIVENESS.definition: The drive to restore fractured relationships by releasing resentment and making amends.

NEED_PURPOSE.definition: The search for meaningful contribution, utility, or role within a group.

NEED_SELF_REGULATION.definition: Managing impulses, attention, emotion, and behavior.

NEED_CONTENTMENT.definition: Satisfaction with what is; the antidote to comparison and envy.

NEED_TRUST.definition: Belief in another's reliability — a precondition for connection, distinct from the bond itself.

NEED_INTEGRITY.definition: Self-honesty and consistency between values and action.

NEED_CONFIDENCE.definition: Felt self-belief, distinct from Competence's skill-mastery.

SIT140.true_belief_text: Kindness and generosity can make a real difference.

SIT141.title: Saw a parent or teacher break a rule they enforce
SIT141.false_belief_text: Rules only matter when they're convenient.
SIT141.true_belief_text: I can choose integrity regardless of what others do.

SIT142.title: Someone online asked for their personal password
SIT142.true_belief_text: I protect myself by making safe choices and asking trusted adults.

SIT143.title: Saw someone litter and felt upset but said nothing
SIT143.true_belief_text: Small responsible actions help care for our world.

SIT144.title: Saw a stray animal being treated badly
SIT144.false_belief_text: It's not my place to help.
SIT144.true_belief_text: Every living being deserves kindness and care.

SIT145.title: Failed to keep a promise they made to a friend
SIT145.false_belief_text: One broken promise means the friendship is ruined.
SIT145.true_belief_text: Trust can be rebuilt through honesty and consistent actions.

SIT146.title: Feels guilty for not including someone in play
SIT146.false_belief_text: There's only room for some people.
SIT146.true_belief_text: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

SIT147.title: Friend said something mean about their culture or family
SIT147.false_belief_text: I should hide who I am to fit in.
SIT147.true_belief_text: My identity deserves respect, and I can respect others too.

SIT148.title: Found something and doesn't know whether to keep it
SIT148.false_belief_text: If I found it, it belongs to me.
SIT148.true_belief_text: Doing the right thing matters more than getting something extra.

SIT149.title: Overheard talk about politics, protests, or injustice
SIT149.false_belief_text: The world is only unfair and nothing can change.
SIT149.true_belief_text: Fairness grows through understanding, courage and responsible action.

SIT150.title: Best friend makes a new best friend
SIT150.false_belief_text: If my friend likes someone else, I'll be forgotten.
SIT150.true_belief_text: Friendships can grow without replacing each other.

SIT151.title: Friends don't reply to messages
SIT151.false_belief_text: No reply means they don't care about me.
SIT151.true_belief_text: I shouldn't assume the worst before I know the truth.

SIT152.title: Accidentally left out of a game
SIT152.false_belief_text: Being left out means I don't belong.
SIT152.true_belief_text: I can help create spaces where everyone belongs.

SIT153.title: A secret wasn't shared with them
SIT153.false_belief_text: If I'm not told everything, I'm not important.
SIT153.true_belief_text: Trust grows through honesty, not knowing every secret.

SIT154.title: Friend copies their work or idea
SIT154.false_belief_text: If someone copies me, I've lost what makes me special.
SIT154.true_belief_text: My ideas and creativity remain valuable.

SIT155.title: A friend wins while they lose
SIT155.false_belief_text: Someone else's success makes me less successful.
SIT155.true_belief_text: I can celebrate others while continuing my own journey.

SIT156.title: Friend breaks a promise
SIT156.false_belief_text: Once trust is broken, it can never be repaired.
SIT156.true_belief_text: Honest conversations and actions can rebuild trust.

SIT157.title: Rumours or gossip spread about them
SIT157.false_belief_text: I have to prove myself to everyone.
SIT157.true_belief_text: Truth and character matter more than rumours.

SIT158.title: Friend apologises after hurting them
SIT158.false_belief_text: Holding on to hurt keeps me safe.
SIT158.true_belief_text: Forgiveness helps relationships heal and grow.

SIT159.title: They hurt a friend's feelings by mistake
SIT159.false_belief_text: One mistake makes me a bad friend.
SIT159.true_belief_text: I can apologise, repair and learn from my mistakes.

SIT160.title: Asked to choose between two friends
SIT160.false_belief_text: I have to choose one person over another.
SIT160.true_belief_text: I can be kind and fair to everyone.

SIT161.title: Lost during a team game because of their mistake
SIT161.true_belief_text: Mistakes are part of teamwork and learning.

SIT162.title: Teammate isn't doing their part
SIT162.false_belief_text: I have to control others for things to go well.
SIT162.true_belief_text: Cooperation grows through patience and communication.

SIT163.title: Friend gets a pet they always wanted
SIT163.false_belief_text: Life is unfair because I don't have what they have.
SIT163.true_belief_text: I can be genuinely happy for others while appreciating my own life.

SIT164.title: A younger child wants to join the game
SIT164.false_belief_text: Younger children will spoil our fun.
SIT164.true_belief_text: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

SIT165.title: Friend is nervous before a performance
SIT165.false_belief_text: It's not my job to help.
SIT165.true_belief_text: Encouragement can help someone become brave.

SIT166.title: Classmate is new and sitting alone
SIT166.true_belief_text: Small acts of kindness can make someone feel welcome.

SIT167.title: Friend keeps interrupting while talking
SIT167.false_belief_text: The loudest person should be heard.
SIT167.true_belief_text: Listening is an important way to show respect.

SIT168.title: Group project where everyone has different ideas
SIT168.false_belief_text: My idea has to be chosen.
SIT168.true_belief_text: Great ideas grow when people work together.

B_SAN_01.name: Sanctuary Establishment
B_SAN_01.purpose: Establish emotional/physical equilibrium before any disruption.

B_ROU_01.name: Routine Cataloging
B_ROU_01.purpose: Ground the reader in the character's normal world through repeated, listable detail.

B_DEP_01.name: Departure
B_DEP_01.purpose: Character leaves the safe/known state, initiating the journey.

B_THR_01.name: Threshold Crossing
B_THR_01.purpose: Character crosses into a world with different rules than the one they know.

B_VUL_01.name: Vulnerability Exposure
B_VUL_01.purpose: Establish the character's exposed, at-risk state before a threat appears.

B_THREAT_01.name: Threat Appearance
B_THREAT_01.purpose: An antagonist or danger enters, forcing a response.

B_EXP_01.name: Exploration
B_EXP_01.purpose: Character investigates the new environment, gathering sensory/narrative information.

B_DIS_01.name: Discovery
B_DIS_01.purpose: Character finds a key object, clue, or fact that changes the situation.

B_DEF_01.name: Active Defense
B_DEF_01.purpose: Character takes an initial defensive or evasive action against the threat.

B_INV_01.name: Strategic Invention
B_INV_01.purpose: Character devises a clever, non-physical solution (wit over force).

B_TEST_01.name: Physical/Bluff Test
B_TEST_01.purpose: The invented plan is tested against the antagonist or obstacle.

B_ESC_01.name: Sequential Escalation
B_ESC_01.purpose: Stakes, demands, or chaos increase in a repeating, causal pattern.

B_PEAK_01.name: Peak Chaos
B_PEAK_01.purpose: The escalation reaches its maximum point before resolution.

B_FAIL_01.name: Failed Attempt
B_FAIL_01.purpose: An attempted solution does not work, forcing reassessment.

B_REFLECT_01.name: Reflective Pause
B_REFLECT_01.purpose: Character stops to reconsider approach after a setback.

B_SMALLWIN_01.name: Small Success
B_SMALLWIN_01.purpose: A modest win rebuilds confidence and momentum after failure.

B_PRESSURE_01.name: External Pressure
B_PRESSURE_01.purpose: Outside forces (peers, comparison) intensify the character's false belief.

B_MIRROR_01.name: Mentor Mirror
B_MIRROR_01.purpose: A mentor or reflective moment shows the character a new way of seeing, without lecturing.

B_REFRAME_01.name: Reframed Reality
B_REFRAME_01.purpose: The character's false belief is replaced by the true belief through observation, not instruction.

B_DEC_01.name: Decision Point
B_DEC_01.purpose: Character must choose between two values or paths, revealing character.

B_SAC_01.name: Sacrifice
B_SAC_01.purpose: Character gives up something of value to advance the mission or help another.

B_RESET_01.name: Restorative Reset
B_RESET_01.purpose: Chaos is resolved and a circular reset to baseline occurs.

B_DEESC_01.name: De-escalation
B_DEESC_01.purpose: Sensory or emotional intensity gradually decreases (e.g. bedtime dimming).

B_MASTERY_01.name: Empowered Mastery
B_MASTERY_01.purpose: Character demonstrates newly won competence or confidence.

B_RET_01.name: Return
B_RET_01.purpose: Character returns to the sanctuary or starting point, now changed.

B_ANC_01.name: Anchor Validation
B_ANC_01.purpose: A physical anchor object/detail proves safety remained constant (the 'still hot supper' beat). Mandatory closure for Safety Loop.

B_CEL_01.name: Celebration
B_CEL_01.purpose: Community or relational joy marks the mission's success.

B_VISITOR_01.name: Catalyst Arrival
B_VISITOR_01.purpose: An outside visitor disrupts routine, introducing new possibility.

B_ADAPT_01.name: Adaptation
B_ADAPT_01.purpose: Character adjusts to the disruption, finding new joy or routine.

B_VISITOR_02.name: Catalyst Departure
B_VISITOR_02.purpose: The visitor leaves, and routine resumes changed by the encounter.
